answer.rationale: Write-path p99 degradation began roughly when the release went out 2 hours ago (90 min of climbing latency), making the release the leading suspect. Read-replica routing (b5) targets read load, not the write path, and circuit breakers (b4) target a failing dependency, which isn't indicated. Failover (b2) doesn't address a bad build. Rollback per memory_b1 previously cleared a checkout error spike with no customer impact and preserves in-flight writes if the rollback is write-safe. I want to verify b1 to confirm rollback safety under write load, and b3 because if verification shows the release is innocent, add_capacity becomes the fallback given peak settlement traffic. Capacity for one intervention means I commit to rollback as the highest-probability, most reversible action.
